scenario.title: Staffing and worker session control
situations: A strategy document should turn into staffed work.
A worker needs to be launched on another machine.
A worker fails, parks or needs a different level.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Is capacity-sharing setup discoverable from a no-eligible-machine launch refusal?
Does a global projectless steering session receive all necessary routes after P1-P4?

lessons.title: Choose the staffing entrypoint
lessons.when: The user wants work staffed from a plan rather than one foreground task
lessons.need: Steer holds scope and staffs; Charge selects runnable frontier work. A steering session does not implement. Learn the current pinned next skill from the live item rather than a remembered chain.
lessons.surface: Docs index/session loop -> Steer skill -> scope and continuous-pass homes.

lessons.title: Preview the registered launch
lessons.when: Immediately before staffing an item or an itemless mandate
lessons.need: Use registered launch preview/create; the engine composes item mandates. Read the selected level, machine and blockers. The opening hook binds through its launch-specific attestation, never folder/time proximity. An assigned worker must acknowledge and claim its own item before the deadline. Missing entry names launch_work_claim_missing and releases launch-only staffing. Read launch get for the exact session and recovery evidence.
lessons.surface: Steer worker-launch and model-selection -> launch help/preview.
recipes: yoke session-control launch preview --project P --level SENIOR

lessons.title: Understand hand-back, parking and restaffing
lessons.when: A launched turn returns or an existing worker needs a different level
lessons.need: A tool continuation handle is still running; a returned turn is not completion. Preserve the checkpoint and actual wake/park path. Changing a running worker level requires the supported successor/restaff path, not editing its live model.
lessons.surface: Steer worker-launch -> worker-lifecycle/model-selection; session and launch evidence.
lessons.gap: Only the guidance chain was traced; individual harness wake and physical termination mechanics belong to runtime verification.
